QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] The New Head Captain
QuestInfo.0: You received word from Levy. What could it be about?
QuestInfo.1: You have an idea of what the captains of the Argent Guard want you to do...but is it what you need to do, to turn back the darkness?
QuestInfo.2: The captains of the Argent Guard offered you the position of head captain but you declined. When you reminded yourself of your determination to become strong enough to face any darkness, you felt the light inside enveloping you.
